description:
Who holds a portfolio of properties in the Twin Cities metro and where their tax bill is sent, including out-of-state holders and private landlords with three or more homes. Returns the true matching count, up to six example rows, and a link to the dataset's documentation.

Example invocations:
- "Which out-of-state companies own homes in Saint Paul?"
- "Who are the biggest landlords near 3000 Bloomington Ave, Minneapolis?"

address.description: A street address inside the seven-county metro, to answer about ONE property instead of the whole market. Include the city after a comma when the street name is common — 'Grand Ave' exists in several of these cities.

cut.description: all: every holder of 3+ parcels; landlords: private holders of three or more homes; big: ten or more parcels; out_of_state: billed outside Minnesota; public: public agencies. Default all.

within_ft.description: Radius in feet around `address`. Default 5280 (one mile), capped at 26400.

name: landlord_portfolios
title: Landlord Portfolios
